issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify a method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) while the provided code (both the template's example usage and the solution) uses a different method name computeMealCost(Meal). This naming mismatch for the same conceptual operation (computing the total price of a Meal) can confuse students about which method to implement and call, and may cause integration or test failures if names are assumed to be consistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement and UML to refer to computeMealCost(Meal) or rename the method in code to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (and update all references such as in Main). Ensure the chosen name matches the signature described in the specification (static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal) if keeping the problem statement).
